label: Zillow Scraper
title: Zillow Scraper: For Sale, Rent & Sold Listings
metaDescription: Scrape Zillow by location or search URL, for sale, for rent or sold: price, address, beds, baths, size, Zestimate, tax value, agent and photos.
intro: Search Zillow by location or paste a search link (for sale, for rent or recently sold) and get price, address, beds, baths, size, Zestimate, tax value, agent and every photo. Large areas are split automatically.
useCases: Pull sold comps for a valuation
Find rentals and their prices in a ZIP code
Track new for-sale listings in a market

faq.q: Does Zillow have a public API?
faq.a: Zillow retired its old public APIs in 2021; its data now goes to approved partners through Bridge Interactive. This actor reads the public Zillow pages instead.
